You extend a hand toward the restless creature and speak a quiet dismissal. A pale thread of Life energy lashes from your fingers into it.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One visible creature within 4 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Attack / Recovery

Speak a quiet dismissal and send a thread of Life energy into the target. This is a damaging spell, not free healing; it restores no HP.

Weak
3 Life damage.
Standard
3 Life damage; a creature explicitly harmed by healing is also pushed 1 square.
Strong
5 Life damage; such a creature is pushed 2 squares.
